manifest.scope: Development ablation on the previous 39 already-observed configurations, not independent validation. All methods share static-join grounding and indexed exact search. Only optional threshold inference differs. No external baselines or LLM experiments rerun.
manifest.budget: Each optional variant: <=3 nominal seconds/run, <=0.25s/query, >=0.025s remaining to start, <=64 attempts/run. Atomic SAT query can overrun. Singleton BFS: <=64 states/query, <=4096 states/run, <=4096 transitions/query, <=65536 transitions/run, nominal <=0.05s/query and <=1s/run excluding hmax. Global hmax budget 2000000 effect checks (last check can exceed by one).
manifest.gate: Query only current decision threshold d. If scalar C0<N, prune. Otherwise evaluate its chosen abstract witness under candidate identities. If witness>=N, skip with a certificate that the lineage recurrence cannot prune. Else evaluate lineage only if resource pressure>0 or C0(d-1)<N. The latter pressure filter schedules work and has no infeasibility force.
